subject: E-Commerce
title: The Shoppable Feed
description: A 60-second lesson on The Shoppable Feed.

hook.text: Instagram added product tags to photos in 2018. Tap a bag in a photo and buy it instantly. Content became a store.

buildup.text: Before product tags, brands put 'link in bio' as their only shopping pathway. It was clunky and lost customers.

discovery.text: Shoppable posts reduced the path from inspiration to purchase to a single tap. Friction nearly disappeared.

twist.text: Instagram dropped its dedicated Shop tab in 2023. Users preferred Reels. Video won over catalog browsing.

climax.text: Instagram proved that images sell, but video sells more. The platform pivoted from photo catalog to video store.

punchline.text: Tap the dress, buy the dress. Instagram turned every photo into a storefront.

quiz.question: Why did Instagram remove its dedicated Shop tab?
options: Users preferred Reels—video drove more engagement than catalog browsing
